options.name: Ore Whisper
options.summary: While undocked, ore within 16 m glows at its rim through up to 1 m of rock.

options.name: Breathing Room
options.summary: Once per dock cycle, the first collapse warning on your tunnels is braced and filled.

options.name: Assay Beacon
options.summary: At the Sell bay, ore from the shallow bands sells at the mid-band price.
